what: When the panel comes up past 10% above the screen bottom, a boundary tilted 126° sweeps left to right in 1.2s cubic-bezier(.3,0,.3,1), revealing the panel, and an accent-color band (150px) passes just ahead of the boundary, leaving a knife-cut hatch line. The ”wide” type (wide panel) uses a 600px band · 1.5s. Once fully swept, the mask is removed

options.look: wide: Wide panel — band 600px · 1.5s (panel wider than the original @container 50vw)
options.at: Share subtracted from the bottom of the screen (IntersectionObserver rootMargin bottom), default -10%
options.--fx-color: Band color (via style), default --kf-accent — the original uses each card’s paired color (--keycolor)

from.where: corp.css .ky-slash (original uSlashshow — mask 126° 50% edge · a --keycolor band of 150rem on ::after, 600rem if the panel is over 50vw · 1.5s, when done it goes to _finished and the mask is removed)
